name: Incident — Natural Disaster Response (1 Week)
description: A one-week template for managing a natural disaster response — storm, flood, earthquake, or wildfire. Covers initial emergency response, sustained operations, and transition to recovery. Suitable for emergency management agencies, municipalities, and civil protection.

groups.name: Field Teams
groups.description: Search and rescue, emergency services, field workers

events.title: DISASTER EVENT — Response Activated
events.description: Natural disaster event occurs or warning received. Emergency operations centre activated.

events.title: Initial Damage Assessment
events.description: Field teams conduct rapid assessment of affected area. Report scope and severity.

events.title: Emergency Public Warning
events.description: Issue public safety warnings via all channels: sirens, SMS, radio, social media.

events.title: Resource Mobilisation
events.description: Deploy available resources: vehicles, equipment, shelter supplies, personnel.

events.title: Day 1 Evening — SITREP #1
events.description: End of first day situation report: areas affected, resources deployed, immediate needs.

events.title: Day 2 — Morning Briefing
events.description: Operational briefing for all teams. Priorities for the day. Resource requests.

events.title: Day 2 — Sustained Field Operations
events.description: Continued search, rescue, and emergency services across affected areas.

events.title: Day 3 — Logistics Resupply
events.description: Major resupply operation: food, water, medical supplies, shelter materials.

events.title: Day 3 — Decision: Expand or Maintain Operations
events.description: Command decides whether to expand, maintain, or scale down operations.

events.title: Day 4 — Daily SITREP
events.description: Mid-week situation report. Progress, outstanding needs, resource status.

events.title: Day 5 — Begin Transition Planning
events.description: Start planning transition from emergency response to recovery phase.

events.title: Day 6 — Scale Down Field Operations
events.description: Reduce emergency posture. Transition field teams to recovery support.

events.title: Day 7 — Recovery Handover
events.description: Formal handover from emergency response to long-term recovery coordination.

events.title: Day 7 — After Action Review
events.description: Review response: what worked, what didn't, improvements for future events.

events.title: EMERGENCY RESPONSE PHASE CLOSED
events.description: Emergency response formally concluded. Recovery phase continues separately.
